lines.text: Want to grab a bite after class?

data.define: To eat something small and quick.

example.text: Want to grab a bite after class?

misuse.text: Don't say 'grab a bite' before a seven-course dinner.
misuse.why: It means a quick, light meal.

publish.title: What does "grab a bite" mean?
publish.value: Grab a bite = Have a quick meal. Example: "Want to grab a bite after class?" (casual English, US).
